'''2017 EGP Brandon Baity DS Tatooine: Desert Landing Site''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Baity]] at [[2017 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brandon Baity]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Desert Landing Site|Tat-D-tatooinedesertlandingsite.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|According To My Design|V1-D-accordingtomydesign.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Tatooine Desert Landing Sit Baity.txt |Download]]
